list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone, or email
list.empty: No client cards yet. Add one to keep track of contacts.

detail.cardVsAccount: A client card is contact information only. To give a customer access, invite them from project settings.
detail.noLinkable: No projects can be linked. A project can belong to only one client card.
detail.oneCardPerProject: A project can be linked to only one client card.

restore.title: Restore this client card?
restore.body: It will appear in the client list again.

unlink.title: Unlink this project?
unlink.body: This removes the link between “{project}” and this client card. Both the project and the card stay, and you can link them again later.
